appraisal_events.evidence: elle ne put se défendre d'un tel sentiment d'admiration pour une femme qui possédait à ce point l'esprit des Guermantes qu'elle voulut inviter la princesse d'Épinay à l'Opéra.
appraisal_events.explanation: Despite privately finding her ugly, stingy, and unpleasant, the princesse de Parme is so impressed by Mme d'Épinay's parroted borrowing of Guermantes turns of phrase that she resolves to invite her to the Opera -- a concrete elevation built on a misunderstanding neither woman actually recognizes.

appraisal_events.evidence: elle raconta en rentrant chez elle combien la princesse de Parme avait eu de peine à comprendre Taquin le Superbe et combien il fallait qu'Oriane fût snob pour avoir dans son intimité une pareille dinde.
appraisal_events.explanation: The same Mme d'Épinay who fawned over the princesse de Parme's admiration turns around at home and mocks her as a fool ('une dinde'), exposing the hollowness of the courtesies just exchanged.

appraisal_events.evidence: ce fut du fond du cœur qu'elle put assurer à la duchesse qu'elle n'avait jamais passé une meilleure journée ni assisté à une fête plus réussie.
appraisal_events.explanation: Where a Courvoisier hostess's rigidly logical bonapartist-only guest list left princesse Mathilde stranded with dull nonentities, Mme de Guermantes curates an effortlessly perfect, wide-ranging gathering that earns the princess's most heartfelt praise.

appraisal_events.evidence: des horizons qui lui paraissaient inouïs et lui restaient confus... la culture infiniment arriérée de la princesse... l'incapacité où était Mme de Parme de séparer le véritable esprit des Guermantes des formes rudimentairement apprises de cet esprit.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator repeatedly stresses the princesse de Parme's backward culture and her inability to tell real Guermantes wit from crude imitations, leaving her perpetually stupefied and confused by paradoxes she cannot actually follow, while also noting that the duchesse's own paradoxes succeed only because her listener is even less advanced than she is.

status_effects.explanation: She gains a real social benefit -- a coveted Opera invitation from a sovereign princess -- purely through mistaken association with Oriane's celebrated wit.
She is privately ridiculed as slow-witted by the very woman she had just flattered and tried to favor, undercutting the admiration staged moments before.
A reigning princess declares this the best party she has ever attended, an emphatic, witnessed validation of the duchesse's social mastery, sharply contrasted with the Courvoisier hostess's failure.
She is left overwhelmed and confused by the duchesse's contrarian pronouncements, unable to keep pace intellectually.
The narrator deflates the duchesse's own supposed originality, noting she is herself far less advanced than she believes -- her paradoxes stupefy only because her listener is even further behind.
